test_title: PYST 9: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - English Language (Held On 29 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
A sentence is provided in indirect speech. From the four given options, choose the one that most accurately conveys the sentence in its corresponding direct speech:

The officer asserted that the operation could not have succeeded without local support.

options.text: "The operation could not have succeeded without local support," asserted the officer.
"The operation succeeded without local support," said the officer.
"Local support must have failed the operation," claimed the officer.
Without support, the operation will not succeed," said the officer.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indirect Speech:** The officer asserted that the operation could not have succeeded without local support.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **"could not have succeeded without local support" remains "could not have succeeded without local support"**
 
 
• The meaning of the sentence remains unchanged during the conversion.
 
• The verb tense "could not have succeeded" is retained as it accurately conveys the past hypothetical scenario.
 
 
 
• **"asserted" remains "asserted"**
 
 
• The reporting verb "asserted" accurately reflects the officer's firm statement.
 
 
 
 
 
• **Punctuation and Format:**
 
 
• Direct speech is enclosed in quotation marks.
 
• Starts with a capital letter "The" and ends with a period ".".
 
• Reporting clause follows the quoted speech, starting with a lowercase letter after the comma.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"“The operation could not have succeeded without local support,” asserted the officer."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2:** "The operation succeeded without local support," said the officer.
 
 
• Incorrect meaning: Changes the sentence to indicate the operation succeeded, contrary to the original statement.
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** "Local support must have failed the operation," claimed the officer.
 
 
• Incorrect interpretation: Suggests local support caused failure, which is not implied in the original sentence.
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** "Without support, the operation will not succeed," said the officer.
 
 
• Incorrect tense: Changes the hypothetical past scenario to a future possibility, altering the meaning.
 
 
</ul
